events.verdict: Green (GSW) puts his hand to the front of Gobert (UTA), but does not affect his SQBR.
Curry (GSW) briefly places an arm around Ingles (UTA) before correcting.
Green (GSW) makes some contact to Gobert's (UTA) arm, but does not affect his ability to control of the ball.
Gobert (UTA) slightly extends his arm into Thompson (GSW), but does not dislodge him from his legally obtained position.
Thompson (GSW) makes contact with Mitchell's (UTA) body during the follow-through on his jump shot and affects his ability to follow-through naturally.
Ingles (UTA) and Green (GSW) engage then disengage during the rebound.
Rubio (UTA) veers into McKinnie's (GSW) path and initiates marginal contact during the drive in transition.
Rubio (UTA) absorbs the contact from Durant (GSW) during the pick.
McKinnie (GSW) briefly places his hand on the opposite side hip of Gobert (UTA) and removes it. The contact does not affect Gobert's FOM.
Rubio (UTA) maintains legal guarding position as Curry (GSW) sets the screen.
[Observable in enhanced video] Green (GSW) keeps his foot on the line and is not actively guarding an opponent for longer than three seconds.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: The ball is last touched by Mitchell (UTA).
[Observable in enhanced video] Durant (GSW) slides his pivot foot after the gather.
[Observable in enhanced video] Thompson (GSW) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Iguodala (GSW) commits a take foul on Mitchell (UTA).
